newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ weekly movement drops to 5.215 mln gallons.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ weekly movement drops to 5.215 mln gallons.

text.p: The Florida Citrus Processors Association said frozen concentrated orange juice movement into trade channels for the week ended March 8 was 5,215,248 gallons compared with 8,197,346 gallons last week.
Imports were 424,913 gallons compared with 758,822 gallons the previous week.
There were no domestic receipts for this week or the previous week.
Retail movement was 1,140,876 gallons, while bulk movement was 3,421,545 gallons.
Current season cumulative movement was 75,213,435 gallons.
The final total pack for the season is 156,186,205 gallons.
